description: The '1.6× A=3 magnitude near-miss' is a UNITS ARTIFACT. The derived 3-body cluster c₃=0.297 is a genuine ENERGY (MeV; E₀=m_e/(q₀(q₀−1))·deficit) but is compared directly to the DIMENSIONLESS simplex coefficient μ₃=0.4708 (ρ_strong−ρ_grad, a pure ratio) — the borromean probe line 188 admits it: 'μ₃ (dimensionless, read as MeV)'. Converting the cluster into the dimensionless decomposition (c₃/B(²H)=0.1335) gives the honest A=3 3-body gap 3.53× (not 1.6×): the cluster supplies 28% (not 63%) of the target, and the energy-consistent binding miss is 8.85%/0.750 MeV (not 4.6%). The correction factor is exactly B(²H)=2.224566. The order-separation strengthens (required h⁶ coeff 57.8 vs 13.4). A=4 |c₄|/c₃ becomes 26.6 (vs 13.1). scope-(a) calibration — corrects the corpus (#4364, three-walls, borromean probe:188) and this PR's §2–3c corpus-convention numbers; the A=3 magnitude is ~2× further from closure than the headline, reinforcing Δ_λ-gating. No fit; nothing wired; exact (mpmath).
